_finding: The verify answer and the badge are what other pages and agents trust. It must decide by the exact address only, refuse to answer from a registry it could not refresh (a false 'not listed' would accuse a token we failed to look up), ignore address case, and never let a value reach the SVG unescaped.

mutations.name: a copied symbol makes a token listed
mutations.find: const rec = records.find((r) => r.address === addr) || null
mutations.replace: const rec = records.find((r) => r.address === addr || (impostor && r.symbol === impostor.registry_symbol)) || null
mutations.expect: FAIL a token copying a listed symbol is not listed

mutations.name: a stale registry still answers
mutations.expect: FAIL a registry older than the limit is unavailable

mutations.name: the address is matched case-sensitively
mutations.expect: FAIL a mixed-case address is the same answer

mutations.name: borrowing a ticker is called an impostor
mutations.expect: FAIL reusing a bare ticker is not called an impostor
